summary: This is a routine 8-K filing reporting entry into eight equipment supply contracts between a wholly owned subsidiary of Evolution Metals Technologies Corp. and ULVAC Korea for vacuum induction melting and sintering furnaces used in rare earth metal production. Terms include DDP delivery by November 30, 2026, milestone-based four-installment payment, performance bond and cargo insurance requirements, and FAT condition. No special situation is present. This is an ordinary operational contract filing, not a special situation.
